promoted_snapshot.note: Promoted DAG state only. Historical failed package attempts remain retained separately and do not become promoted FAIL after a later PASS.

readiness_state_model.runnable: A real package attempt is technically valid with the current runner lane and retained predecessors.
readiness_state_model.lane-pending: The node is topologically available but must not be attempted until a runner can validate its package surface without false CI failures.
readiness_state_model.dependency-blocked: The node cannot yet be attempted because a required local predecessor has no retained PASS artifact.
readiness_state_model.note: Readiness states are campaign-planning metadata. They are not DAG PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED results.

multi-abi.required_capability: validate multiple runtime ABIs/symbol files and package splits in one source build

qml-multisurface.required_capability: validate QML-heavy packages, multiple libraries, QML imports and runtime closure

multi-surface-optional.required_capability: validate multiple libraries plus optional/provider-selected feature surfaces without silently disabling upstream defaults

local-predecessor.required_capability: consume the retained local KCoreAddons PASS -dev/runtime artifacts rather than Ubuntu KDE packages
